strategies.name: Single: spread baseline
strategies.description: B0 scoring means as a benchmark; test opponent-adjusted and shrinkage alternatives chronologically.

G1.rule: Verified snapshot inputs, field-level sources; third-party prices excluded.

G2.rule: Timestamped pre-kickoff inputs and prices, with complete as-of history. Current capture dates alone do not establish availability at each past decision.

G3.rule: Chronological training / validation / untouched test; no in-sample standings used to prove predictive skill.

G4.rule: Current final injuries, active roster and usage; No Injuries Reported is not clearance.

G5.rule: Operator-native timestamped line, price, settlement and void rules. No assumed -110 pricing.

G6.rule: Out-of-sample calibrated probabilities; aligned outcomes and joint distribution for combos. Team correlations cannot price bets.

G7.rule: Positive conservative net EV after costs and pushes, robust across seasons; pre-registered family-wide uncertainty adjustment.

G8.rule: Prospective immutable paper ledger, exposure caps, drawdown stress tests. No rewards before every applicable gate passes.
